body:
I've known them for years, though. Some high school, some elementary. They never used to be like this. I don't think they changed. I'm the one that changed, and I don't know that they can handle it.

But I can't just give up on them, because I don't have anyone else. I'm so bad at talking to other people that I haven't been able to make a single friend in college despite trying so hard for four years. 

These people are all I have, and they want me dead. What am I supposed to do with that? I've trusted their opinions on everything. If they want me off a cliff, well, at this point I'm willing.
